name: Mega Cat Studios Collection 3
summary:
The Mega Cat Studios Collection 3 cartridge brings 10 more modern-retro indie games from Mega Cat Studios to the Evercade!

Included Games:
- Flap Happy — An 8-bit avian platformer: flap your wings, defy gravity and avoid menacing sharks across hazardous landscapes.
- Gravibots — A gravity-flipping puzzle game where you change your polarity to cling to ceilings and move blocks to defeat foes.
- GunTneR — A shoot 'em up sending you to the 13th Dimension to save a sickly pet dingle, armed with a Quark Cannon and an unstable Chaos Cannon.
- Kudzu — A story-driven action-adventure following a search for a missing gardening master through a labyrinth of invasive kudzu.
- Machine Cave — A physics-based piloting game exploring an interstellar maze, balancing momentum, buoyancy and gravity.
- The Meating — A puzzle platformer starring a spectral minotaur seeking vengeance.
- Plyuk — A puzzle game following a cloning creature escaping a nefarious laboratory.
- Rocket Panda — A jetpack action-adventure through dangerous mazes to defeat the evil Biscuit Head.
- Super Fanger — A 16-bit multiplayer thriller where you chase down friends or evade their pursuit.
- Gumball in Trick-or-Treat Land — An 8-bit role-playing adventure helping Gumball find his way home while battling the Chaos Sweets.
